descriptionByLocale.en:
Your Missions
• You are actively contributing to the industrialization of our products through the analysis of digital models (DMUs) and the anticipation of future production needs
• You control the definition and optimization of the assembly and pre-assembly sequences of our engines
• You guarantee the feasibility and efficiency of assembly operations by studying the accessibility of assembly areas and tools
• You identify and prevent collisions between components, installations and tools in order to ensure a smooth and secure production process
• You participate in the assembly of motors to have a perfect knowledge of production techniques and to make their requests for improvement go back up
• You transform your analyses into concrete recommendations and technical reports with high added value
• You are involved in the continuous improvement of our production methods and in the deployment of new industrial steering tools
• You conduct strategic studies and provide key analyses to support the Directorate's decision making
• You collaborate with the production teams to perform tests on the assembly lines, and compare the analyses to reality Your Profile
• You have a degree in Engineering or equivalent training in Industrial Engineering or Mechanical Engineering, with a specialization in Design or similar fields
• You benefit from minimum 2 to 5 years experience in mechanical design or simulation
• You are fluent in oral and written English and have a good level of French. Knowledge in German is an asset
• You use MS Office with ease and have good basic knowledge of Pro/Engineer – CREO and ideally Teamcenter Visual Mockup
• You are passionate about technology and have a special interest in Diesel engines and complex industrial environments
• You have flexibility, agility and a strong sense of responsibility. You stand out for your optimistic attitude, openness to change and communication skills Our Offer Can we motivate you to take on a key role in a family, dynamic and independent business? We encourage you to share and develop your ideas and offer you a safe job, modern working conditions that are compatible with family life, such as flexible working hours, the possibility of working in Home Office, a business restaurant, opportunities for continuing training and many other benefits. The workplace is located in Bulle, in the beautiful Gruyère region. Plan your personal and professional development with us. In order to ensure a fair application procedure, we do not accept applications by mail or e-mail. Have we raised your interest? If so, we would be happy to receive your application online. If you have any questions, please contact Kerstin LIMAT. One Passion. Many Opportunities. *A common passion. So many opportunities. Liebherr Machines Bulle SA is the competence centre for combustion engines (diesel and gas) and hydraulic components. The company develops and manufactures diversified products used in civil engineering, mining, agriculture, decentralized energy, mechanical and industrial engineering and aviation. Site Liebherr Machines Bulle SA 7, Rue Hans-Liebherr 1630 Bulle Switzerland (CH) Contact Kerstin LIMAT +41 26 913 31 11
descriptionByLocale.de:
Ihre Aufgaben
• Sie tragen aktiv zur Industrialisierung unserer Produkte durch die Analyse digitaler Modelle (DMU) und die Antizipation zukünftiger Produktionsanforderungen bei.
• Sie verwalten die Definition und Optimierung der Montage- und Vormontagesequenzen unserer Motoren.
• Sie gewährleisten die Durchführbarkeit und Effizienz der Montagevorgänge, indem Sie die Zugänglichkeit von Montagebereichen und Werkzeugen untersuchen.
• Sie identifizieren und verhindern Kollisionsrisiken zwischen Komponenten, Installationen und Werkzeugen, um einen reibungslosen und sicheren Produktionsprozess zu gewährleisten.
• Sie nehmen an der Montage von Motoren teil, um über perfekte Produktionskenntnisse zu verfügen Techniken und geben deren Verbesserungswünsche weiter
• Sie wandeln Ihre Analysen in konkrete Empfehlungen und technische Berichte mit hohem Mehrwert um
• Sie beteiligen sich an der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung unserer Produktionsmethoden und dem Einsatz neuer industrieller Managementinstrumente
• Sie führen strategische Studien durch und liefern Schlüsselanalysen zur Unterstützung der Entscheidungsfindung des Managements
• Sie arbeiten mit den Produktionsteams zusammen, um Tests an den Montagelinien durchzuführen und die Analysen mit der Realität abzugleichen Ihr Profil
• Sie verfügen über ein Ingenieurstudium oder eine gleichwertige Ausbildung im Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder Maschinenbau mit Spezialisierung auf Design oder einem ähnlichen Bereich
• Sie haben mindestens 2 bis 5 Jahre Erfahrung im mechanischen Design oder in der Simulation
• Sie sprechen fließend Englisch in Wort und Schrift und verfügen über gute Französischkenntnisse. Deutschkenntnisse sind von Vorteil
• Sie nutzen MS Office sicher und verfügen über gute Grundkenntnisse in Pro/Engineer – CREO und idealerweise Teamcenter Visual Mockup
• Sie haben eine Leidenschaft für Technik und haben ein besonderes Interesse an Dieselmotoren und komplexen Industrieumgebungen
• Sie zeigen Flexibilität, Agilität und ein ausgeprägtes Verantwortungsbewusstsein
• Sie zeichnen sich durch Ihre optimistische Einstellung, Ihre Offenheit für Veränderungen und Ihre Kommunikationsfähigkeiten aus. Unser Angebot Können wir Sie motivieren, eine Schlüsselrolle in einem dynamischen und unabhängigen Familienunternehmen zu übernehmen? Wir ermutigen Sie, Ihre Ideen zu teilen und weiterzuentwickeln und bieten Ihnen einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz, moderne und familienfreundliche Arbeitsbedingungen wie flexible Arbeitszeiten, die Möglichkeit zum Arbeiten im Homeoffice, ein Betriebsrestaurant, Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und viele weitere Vorteile. Der Arbeitsplatz befindet sich in Bulle, im wunderschönen Gruyère-Gebiet. Planen Sie mit uns Ihre persönliche und berufliche Weiterentwicklung. Um einen fairen Bewerbungsprozess zu gewährleisten, akzeptieren wir keine Bewerbungen per Post oder E-Mail. Haben wir Ihr Interesse geweckt? Dann freuen wir uns über Ihre Online-Bewerbung. Bei Fragen wenden Sie sich bitte an Kerstin LIMAT. Eine Leidenschaft. Viele Möglichkeiten. *Eine gemeinsame Leidenschaft. So viele Möglichkeiten. Liebherr Machines Bulle SA ist das Kompetenzzentrum für Verbrennungsmotoren (Diesel und Gas) und Hydraulikkomponenten. Das Unternehmen entwickelt und produziert vielfältige Produkte für den Einsatz im Bauwesen, im Bergbau, in der Landwirtschaft, in der dezentralen Energieversorgung, im Maschinen- und Industriebau sowie in der Luftfahrt. ​​ Standort Liebherr Machines Bulle SA 7, Rue Hans-Liebherr 1630 Bulle Schweiz (CH) Kontakt Kerstin LIMAT +41 26 913 31 11

jobs.title: Production Engineer DMU (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Your Responsibilities
• You actively contribute to the industrialization of our products through the analysis of Digital Mock-Ups (DMU) and by anticipating future production needs
• You lead the definition and optimization of assembly and pre-assembly sequences for our engines
• You ensure the feasibility and efficiency of assembly operations by studying the accessibility of assembly areas and tooling
• You identify and prevent collision risks between components, installations, and tools to ensure smooth and safe production operations
• You participate in engine assembly activities to gain in-depth knowledge of production techniques and relay improvement requests from the shop floor
• You translate your analyses into concrete recommendations and high value-added technical reports
• You contribute to the continuous improvement of our production methods and the deployment of new industrial management tools
• You carry out strategic studies and provide key analyses to support management decision-making
• You collaborate with production teams in conducting tests on assembly lines and validate analyses against real production conditions Your Profile
• You hold an Engineering degree or an equivalent qualification in Industrial Engineering or Mechanical Engineering, with a specialization in design or a related field
• You have a minimum of 2 to 5 years of experience in mechanical design or simulation
• You are fluent in English, both spoken and written, and have a good level of French. Knowledge of German is considered an asset
• You are proficient in MS Office and have a solid basic knowledge of Pro/Engineer – CREO and ideally Teamcenter Visual Mockup
• You are passionate about technology and have a particular interest in Diesel engines and complex industrial environments
• You demonstrate flexibility, agility, and a strong sense of responsibility
• You stand out through your positive mindset, openness to change, and strong communication skills Our Offer Can we inspire you to take on a responsible position in a dynamic and independent family business? We offer you room for ideas, a secure job, modern and family-friendly employment conditions such as flexible working hours, home office, a company restaurant, training opportunities as well as many benefits. The workplace is located in Bulle, surrounded by the wonderful nature of the Gruyère region. Start planning your personal and professional development with us. In order to ensure a fair application process, we cannot accept applications by post or email. Have we awoken your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your online application. If you have any questions, please contact Kerstin LIMAT. One Passion. Many Opportunities. The company develops and produces various products, which find their use in building construction and civil engineering, mining, agriculture, decentralised energy, machine and plant engineering, as well as aerospace. Location Liebherr Machines Bulle SA 7, Rue Hans-Liebherr 1630 Bulle Switzerland (CH) Contact Kerstin LIMAT +41 26 913 31 11

jobs.description:
Your Responsibilities
• You decide on the technical content and timelines for the development of new engine components, as well as improvements to existing components, in accordance with Project Management
• You define the technical specifications of components to be developed and their key operating parameters
• You work in a cross-functional team to ensure that the chosen technologies and specifications match project requirements (Design, Engine Tests, Electronics, Project Management)
• You support FMEA processes and update and follow up on internal and external engine test activities
• You regularly work with suppliers on technology surveys, component development, and tear-down activities
• You define maintenance requirements for the subsystem and report its development status to the platform manager
• You define the master Design and Validation Plan for the subsystem and prepare technical releases for components under development Your Profile
• You are passionate about combustion engines and motivated to shape the performance and durability of our next‑generation diesel engines
• You have successfully completed a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering
• You have advanced knowledge in the field of combustion engines, DVP&Nr methodology, as well as troubleshooting and problem-solving
• You have extensive experience in the development of cast iron parts, including manufacturing processes, design-for-casting and failure modes
• You have a proven background in engine development, including component design, materials, and a solid understanding of thermo‑mechanical behavior of cylinder heads and crank cases, including heat transfer
• You have an excellent command of English and good knowledge of French or German
• You have an excellent command of MS Office
• You define yourself as an analytical thinker with strong leadership skills. You approach your work with flexibility and resilience, while remaining mindful of cost and resources Our Offer Can we inspire you to take on a responsible position in a dynamic and independent family business? We offer you room for ideas, a secure job, modern and family-friendly employment conditions such as flexible working hours, home office, a company restaurant, training opportunities as well as many benefits. The workplace is located in Bulle, surrounded by the wonderful nature of the Gruyère region. Start planning your personal and professional development with us. In order to ensure a fair application process, we cannot accept applications by post or email. This position is subject to a background check process; the process is conducted by our partner Aequivalent. Have we awoken your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your online application. If you have any questions, please contact Anna KOMARDINA. One Passion. Many Opportunities. • You perform engine 1D-Simulation using AMESim or GT-Power
• You post-treat measurement results with Matlab, Concerto, and other tools
• You carry out mechanical conception and create CAD models of components for prototyping
• You design and dimension components for engines and pumps
• You define the system part list and supplier management
• You present simulation and measurement results
• You develop tools and models for data post-treatment
• You test the engine and complete power train
• You document the developed library for component modeling
• You ensure continuous optimization and validation of the models using measurement data Your Profile
• You hold a Bachelor’s or a Master’s degree in mechanical engineering or similar
• You have at least 3 years of professional experience in combustion engines or a related field
• You bring strong expertise in simulation tools such as Matlab/Simulink, AMESim & Simulation X along with proficiency in Creo and Concerto

jobs.title: Division Controller (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Your Key Responsibilities:
• Monitor KPIs for monthly reporting, prepare reports for top management, and support decisions in close collaboration with the relevant departments.
• Drive inventory controlling on a global level: monitor inventory KPIs, support optimization initiatives, and ensure accurate financial reporting transparency.
• Act as R&D Finance Business Partner: monitor and control R&D spend for the division and Business Units; provide financial steering and decision support to the Head of R&D (plan/forecast, trade-offs, business cases).
• Oversee and manage the financial aspects of various projects, ensuring they remain within budget and meet financial targets, with a strong focus on project controlling.
• Actively develop modern controlling tools and reporting: work closely with BI/IT to build standard dashboards, automate recurring reporting, and improve data quality and transparency.
• Standardize and improve controlling processes: define templates, documentation standards, and streamline end-to-end workflows to increase efficiency and reliability.
• Ensure governance and compliance in controlling deliverables (policies, financial standards, audit readiness).
• Develop and enhance division-wide standardized controlling systems, management processes, and tools.
• Manage ad hoc analyses and stakeholder requests, including preparation of concise management presentations as a basis for decision-making. Your profile:
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
• Minimum 5 years of proven experience in Controlling/Finance (or comparable), preferably in a global manufacturing environment; experience in R&D controlling and inventory/working-capital controlling is a plus.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to work independently and collaboratively in a cross-functional team.
• High attention to detail and accuracy; proactive, structured self-organization and ability to manage multiple priorities.
• IT and data affinity, along with very good MS Office skills (especially Excel and PowerPoint).
• Fluent in English and German (written and spoken); ability to communicate clearly and concisely with stakeholders at different seniority levels. Our offer:
• Enjoy a flexible work environment with the option for home office two days a week.
• Opportunities for continuous learning and career development within a global company.
• Be part of a collaborative and supportive team that values innovation and excellence.
• Work in the beautiful city of Baden, known for its high quality of life and vibrant community.

• Assicurare la governance e la conformità al controllo dei responsabili (politiche, norme finanziarie, disponibilità di audit).

• Laurea o Master in Finanza, Contabilità, Business Administration, o un campo relativo.
• Minimo 5 anni di comprovata esperienza in Controlling/Finance (o paragonabile), preferibilmente in un ambiente di produzione globale; l'esperienza nel controllo della R&D e nel controllo dell'inventario/capitale di lavoro è un vantaggio.

• L'IT e l'affinità dei dati, insieme a competenze di MS Office molto buone (soprattutto Excel e PowerPoint).

jobs.title: Teamleiter - Funktionsvalidierung (m/w/x)
jobs.description:
Ihre Aufgaben
• Sie definieren und setzen die langfristige Vision, die Ziele und die Teststrategie des Teams im Einklang mit den Abteilungszielen um.
• Sie planen, koordinieren und überwachen funktionale Validierungsprogramme an Prüfständen für hydraulische Komponenten.
• Sie stellen hohe Validierungsstandards sicher und treiben Innovationen voran, indem Sie Testmethoden und Best Practices etablieren und kontinuierlich verbessern.
• Sie analysieren Testergebnisse und setzen die Erkenntnisse in konkrete Empfehlungen zur Produktverbesserung um.
• Sie arbeiten eng mit den Bereichen Design Engineering, Qualität und Produktion zusammen, um Testprioritäten abzustimmen und die Produktentwicklung zu unterstützen.
• Sie entwickeln und implementieren standardisierte Prüfverfahren sowie Methoden zur Datenanalyse, um Effizienz, Zuverlässigkeit und Reproduzierbarkeit der Validierungsaktivitäten zu verbessern.
• Sie überwachen den Projektfortschritt, die Ressourcenzuweisung und die Teamleistung und liefern der Abteilungsleitung regelmäßig Updates sowie Empfehlungen.
• Sie stellen die Einhaltung von Sicherheitsstandards in allen Test- und Laboraktivitäten sicher. Ihr Profil
• Sie verfügen über ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Maschinenbau, vorzugsweise mit Spezialisierung auf Mobilhydraulik, mobile Maschinen, Antriebssysteme, Bau- oder Landmaschinen.
• Sie haben nachweisliche Erfahrung in der Entwicklungs- und Validierungstechnik, idealerweise im Bereich hydraulischer Antriebssysteme, mobiler Maschinen oder Off-Highway-Anwendungen.
• Sie besitzen fundierte Kenntnisse in hydraulischen Antrieben, Steuerungssystemen und funktionalen Validierungsmethoden, kombiniert mit einem guten Verständnis von Maschinenfunktionen und Systemverhalten unter realen Betriebsbedingungen.

• En qualité de technicien métrologie, vous assurez la réception, l’étalonnage et l’intégration des moyens de mesure dans les outils de gestion dédiés,
• Vous réalisez les tests de fonctionnement et veillez à la conformité des moyens de mesure,
• Vous effectuez la surveillance périodique ainsi que le suivi des calibrages,
• Vous gérez l’archivage des documents liés aux appareils,
• Vous prenez en charge les petites réparations,
• Vous assurez le suivi des commandes de réparation et le remplacement des équipements de remplacement,
• Vous gérez l’outil Casq-it, avec l’élaboration et la mise à jour des plans de calibrage,
• Vous garantissez le suivi des certifications des machines et appareils de mesure. Votre profil
• Vous êtes titulaire d'un CFC en polymécanique, mécanique ou formation équivalente,
• Vous bénéficiez d'au minimum 5ans d'expérience en mécanique, contrôle de qualité ou métrologie,
• Vous parlez couramment français. L'anglais et l'allemand sont un atout,
• Vous êtes une personne autonome et organisée, dotée d’une forte conscience professionnelle.
• Vous vous distinguez par votre sens aigu des responsabilités et votre aptitude à travailler en équipe. Notre offre Pouvons-nous vous motiver à endosser un rôle clé dans une entreprise familiale, dynamique et indépendante ? Nous vous encourageons à partager et à développer vos idées et vous offrons un emploi sûr, des conditions de travail modernes et conciliables avec la vie familiale telles que des horaires de travail flexibles, la possibilité de travailler en Home office, un restaurant d'entreprise, des perspectives de formation continue et de nombreux autres avantages. Le lieu de travail se situe à Bulle, dans la belle région de la Gruyère. Planifiez avec nous votre développement personnel et professionnel. Afin de garantir une procédure de candidature équitable, nous n’acceptons pas les candidatures par courrier postal ou électronique. Avons-nous suscité votre intérêt ? Si c’est le cas, nous serions ravis de recevoir votre candidature en ligne. Si vous avez des questions, veuillez contacter Nadege MALAN. One Passion. Many Opportunities. *Une passion commune. Tant d’opportunités. L'entreprise Liebherr Machines Bulle SA est le centre de compétences des moteurs à combustion (diesel et gaz) et composants hydrauliques. L’entreprise développe et fabrique des produits diversifiés utilisés dans le génie civil, l'exploitation minière, l'agriculture, l'énergie décentralisée, l'ingénierie mécanique et industrielle ainsi que l'aviation. ​​ Site Liebherr Machines Bulle SA 7, Rue Hans-Liebherr 1630 Bulle Suisse (CH) Contact Nadege MALAN 026 913 31 11

Tu as de l'huile dans le sang et cela ne te déranges pas de te salir les mains pour entretenir des grosses machines de chantiers ? Alors nous avons le métier idéal pour toi ! Tes missons
• Maintenance et réparation des machines, installations et appareils
• Acquisition de connaissances sur les composants mécaniques, électriques, pneumatiques et hydrauliques
• Analyse des causes de défaillance des véhicules défectueux

jobs.description:
Du willst nicht nur Einzelteile bearbeiten, sondern an ganzen Maschinen arbeiten? Dich begeistern Mechanik, Hydraulik und Fahrzeugtechnik – und du suchst eine Aufgabe, bei der du wirklich etwas bewegst? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig. Das bewegst du bei uns
• Montage und Endmontage von Fahrmischern auf LKW-Chassis
• Einbau sowie Inbetriebnahme von mechanischen, hydraulischen und elektrischen Komponenten
• Durchführung von Funktionsprüfungen und Inbetriebnahmen
• Wartung und Reparatur von Fahrmischern und Betonanlagen
• Fehlerdiagnose und selbstständige Störungsbehebung
• Allgemeine Schlosserarbeiten und Blechbearbeitungen Das bringst du mit
• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Baumaschinen-, Landmaschinen- oder LKW-Mechaniker
• Fundierte Erfahrung in Mechanik und Hydraulik ( zwingend erforderlich )
• Erfahrung im Fahrzeugaufbau von Vorteil
• Selbstständige, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
• Teamfähigkeit sowie ein hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein Was wir bieten Als innovatives und modernes Unternehmen in einer erfolgreichen Firmengruppe, bieten wir dir ein vielseitiges, interessantes und anspruchsvolles Aufgabengebiet mit Entwicklungspotenzial. In einem dynamischen Umfeld bieten wir flexible Arbeitszeiten, eine moderne Infrastruktur sowie attraktive Sozialleistungen und Benefits. Haben wir dein Interesse geweckt? Dann freuen wir uns über deine Online-Bewerbung. Bei Fragen kontaktiere bitte Susanne Sulzer. One Passion. Many Opportunities. Das Unternehmen Die Liebherr-Baumaschinen AG mit Sitz in Reiden (Schweiz) ist verantwortlich für den Vertrieb und Service von Erdbewegungs- und Materialumschlagmaschinen, Turmdrehkranen, Betontechnik, Spezialtiefbaumaschinen sowie Mobil- und Raupenkranen in der Schweiz.​ Standort Liebherr-Baumaschinen AG Industriestrasse 18 6260 Reiden Schweiz (CH) Kontakt Susanne Sulzer +41 62 785 82 00

descriptionByLocale.it:
Non volete lavorare solo singoli pezzi, ma anche lavorare su intere macchine? Sei appassionato di meccanica, idraulica e tecnologia automobilistica e stai cercando un lavoro in cui puoi davvero fare la differenza? Allora sei nel posto giusto. Questo è quello che fate con noi
• Montaggio e montaggio finale di autobetoniere su telaio di autocarro
• Installazione e messa in servizio di componenti meccanici, idraulici ed elettrici
• Esecuzione di test funzionali e messa in servizio
• Manutenzione e riparazione di autobetoniere e impianti di betonaggio
• Diagnosi dei guasti e risoluzione dei problemi indipendente
• Lavori generali di fabbro e lavorazione della lamiera Cosa portate con voi
• Formazione completa come meccanico di macchine edili, macchine agricole o camion
• Solida esperienza in meccanica e idraulica (obbligatoria)
• Esperienza nella costruzione di veicoli è un vantaggio
• Indipendente, orientato alle soluzioni modo di lavorare
• Capacità di lavorare in squadra ed elevato senso di responsabilità Cosa offriamo Come azienda innovativa e moderna in un gruppo aziendale di successo, vi offriamo un'area di responsabilità diversificata, interessante ed esigente con potenziale di sviluppo. In un ambiente dinamico offriamo orari di lavoro flessibili, un'infrastruttura moderna e interessanti prestazioni sociali. Abbiamo suscitato il tuo interesse? Allora non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la tua candidatura online. In caso di domande rivolgersi a Susanne Sulzer. Una passione. Molte opportunità. L'azienda Liebherr-Baumaschinen AG con sede a Reiden (Svizzera) è responsabile della vendita e dell'assistenza di macchine per movimento terra e movimentazione materiali, gru a torre, tecnologia del calcestruzzo, macchine speciali per l'ingegneria delle fondazioni nonché gru mobili e cingolate in Svizzera.​ Ubicazione Liebherr-Baumaschinen AG Industriestrasse 18 6260 Reiden Svizzera (CH) Contatto Susanne Sulzer +41 62 785 82 00
descriptionByLocale.en:
Do you not just want to process individual parts, but also work on entire machines? Are you passionate about mechanics, hydraulics and automotive technology – and are you looking for a job where you can really make a difference? Then you've come to the right place. This is what you do with us
• Assembly and final assembly of truck mixers on truck chassis
• Installation and commissioning of mechanical, hydraulic and electrical components
• Carrying out functional tests and commissioning
• Maintenance and repair of truck mixers and concrete plants
• Fault diagnosis and independent troubleshooting
• General locksmith work and sheet metal processing What you bring with you
• Completed training as a construction machine, agricultural machine or truck mechanic
• Sound experience in mechanics and Hydraulics (mandatory)
• Experience in vehicle construction is an advantage
• Independent, solution-oriented way of working
• Ability to work in a team and a high sense of responsibility What we offer As an innovative and modern company in a successful group of companies, we offer you a diverse, interesting and demanding area of responsibility with development potential. In a dynamic environment, we offer flexible working hours, a modern infrastructure and attractive social benefits. Have we piqued your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your online application. If you have any questions, please contact Susanne Sulzer. One Passion. Many opportunities. The company Liebherr-Baumaschinen AG, based in Reiden (Switzerland), is responsible for the sales and service of earthmoving and material handling machines, tower cranes, concrete technology, special foundation engineering machines as well as mobile and crawler cranes in Switzerland.​ Location Liebherr-Baumaschinen AG Industriestrasse 18 6260 Reiden Switzerland (CH) Contact Susanne Sulzer 41 62 785 82 00

jobs.description:
The Head of Product Security is responsible for ensuring the cybersecurity of Liebherr Products/Machines and related digital products throughout their entire lifecycle. The role defines and drives product security strategy, embeds security-by-design into engineering, and ensures compliance with EU product cybersecurity regulations, including the Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) and NIS2, while protecting connected machines, embedded systems, and digital services. Ensuring alignment with business strategies, demands, and risk appetite, working closely with Corporate Product Security Officer, as well as the Product Security Officers/Engineers of Product Segments. Responsibilities:
• Define and lead global product security strategy, roadmap and execution for construction machines and digital products.
• Define product security controls (secure coding, vulnerability management, incident response) based on threat modelling and risk appetite.
• Act as central focal point for product security topics within Corporate Information Security and to internal/external customers for product security matters, risk, regulatory findings
• Define the product security governance framework (policies, standards, controls) and ensure adoption into R&D, engineering, and product lifecycle processes
• Sponsor, build and deploy training, awareness, and support to Engineering teams on security best practices.
• Ensure product compliance with EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), NIS2, and other applicable global regulations
• Embed security-by-design into hardware, firmware, embedded software, and connected platforms.
• Build, mentor and lead a team of product security experts. Foster collaboration with Engineering teams and across Corporate Information Security domains. Competencies:
• A degree in Engineering, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or a related field
• At least 5 years of experience in product or embedded cybersecurity, including 3+ years in a leadership role
• Strong background in embedded systems, connected products, or industrial/IoT security
• Proven ability to translate regulatory and technical requirements into practical engineering execution
• Solid knowledge of standards and regulations such as UNECE R155/R156, EU CRA, IEC 62443, ISO 21434, NIST CSF
• Experience with security testing methods and tools (e.g. SAST, DAST, fuzzing)
• Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills
• Experience in manufacturing, industrial, automotive, or heavy equipment environments is a strong advantage
• Fluent English required; German and French are a plus Our offer: We offer you a secure job, progressive and family-friendly employment conditions such as flexible working hours, hybrid working and opportunities for further training. Have we awoken your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your online application. If you have any questions, please contact Regina Abou el Naga. One Passion. Many Opportunities. The company Liebherr-International AG with its head office in Bulle is the holding company of the Liebherr Group and performs various functions in the areas finance, tax, auditing, legal, insurance, HR, and corporate communication. The Liebherr Group employs more than 55,000 people worldwide in over 150 countries. Location Liebherr-International AG 7, Rue Hans-Liebherr 1630 Bulle Switzerland (CH) Contact Regina Abou el Naga regina.abouelnaga@liebherr.com

Il responsabile della sicurezza del prodotto è responsabile di garantire la sicurezza informatica dei prodotti/macchine Liebherr e dei relativi prodotti digitali durante l'intero ciclo di vita. Il ruolo definisce e guida la strategia di sicurezza del prodotto, integra la sicurezza fin dalla progettazione nell'ingegneria e garantisce la conformità alle normative UE sulla sicurezza informatica dei prodotti, tra cui il Cyber ​​Resilience Act (CRA) e NIS2, proteggendo al contempo le macchine connesse, i sistemi integrati e i servizi digitali. Garantire l'allineamento con le strategie aziendali, le richieste e la propensione al rischio, lavorando a stretto contatto con il responsabile della sicurezza del prodotto aziendale e con i responsabili/ingegneri della sicurezza del prodotto dei segmenti di prodotto. Responsabilità:
• Definire e guidare la strategia globale di sicurezza del prodotto, la tabella di marcia e l'esecuzione per macchine edili e prodotti digitali.
• Definire i controlli di sicurezza del prodotto (codificazione sicura, gestione delle vulnerabilità, risposta agli incidenti) in base alla modellazione delle minacce e alla propensione al rischio.
• Agire come punto focale centrale per gli argomenti relativi alla sicurezza dei prodotti nell'ambito della sicurezza delle informazioni aziendali e per i clienti interni/esterni per questioni relative alla sicurezza dei prodotti, rischi e risultati normativi.
• Definire il quadro di governance della sicurezza del prodotto (politiche, standard, controlli) e garantirne l'adozione nei processi di ricerca e sviluppo, ingegneria e ciclo di vita del prodotto.
• Sponsorizzare, creare e distribuire formazione, sensibilizzazione e supporto ai team di ingegneria sulle migliori pratiche di sicurezza.
• Garantire la conformità dei prodotti con il Cyber ​​Resilience Act (CRA) dell'UE, NIS2 e altre normative globali applicabili.
• Integrare la sicurezza fin dalla progettazione in hardware, firmware, software incorporato e piattaforme connesse.
• Costruire, guidare e guidare un team di esperti di sicurezza del prodotto. Promuovi la collaborazione con i team di ingegneria e nei settori della sicurezza delle informazioni aziendali. Competenze:
• Laurea in ingegneria, sicurezza informatica, informatica o un campo correlato
• Almeno 5 anni di esperienza nella sicurezza informatica di prodotto o integrata, di cui oltre 3 anni in un ruolo di leadership
• Solida esperienza in sistemi integrati, prodotti connessi o sicurezza industriale/IoT
• Comprovata capacità di tradurre requisiti normativi e tecnici in esecuzione pratica di ingegneria
• Solida conoscenza di standard e regolamenti come UNECE R155/R156, EU CRA, IEC 62443, ISO 21434, NIST CSF
• Esperienza con metodi e strumenti di test di sicurezza (ad esempio SAST, DAST, fuzzing)

• Assurer la conformité des produits avec la loi européenne sur la cyber-résilience (CRA), NIS2 et d'autres réglementations mondiales applicables.
• Intégrer la sécurité dès la conception dans le matériel, le micrologiciel, les logiciels intégrés et les plates-formes connectées.

jobs.description:
Vos missions En qualité de collaborateur spécialisé (h/f/x) en tarifications douanières, vous êtes un expert technique (h/f/x) responsable de la classification des marchandises.
• Vous contrôlez et déterminez les codes douaniers ainsi que les origines des marchandises achetées ou fabriquées,
• Vous collaborez étroitement avec les partenaires internes (achats, ventes, développement) et externes (fournisseurs, services douaniers) pour garantir l'exactitude des données,
• Vous gérez les données de base douanières dans notre système ERP,
• Vous collaborez avec les collègues de l'équipe pour la réalisation les déclarations en douane et assurez la conformité réglementaire (import/export),
• Vous apportez votre expertise à l'entreprise sur les questions de règlementations douanières, les règles d'origine et les accords de libre-échange. Votre profil
• Vous êtes titulaire d’un CFC d’employé de commerce (h/f/x).
• Vous avez réalisé une spécialisation en transport/douane, êtes titulaire d'un brevet fédéral de déclarant en douane ou formation similaire, ou justifiez d'une expérience confirmée dans les domaines des tarifications et déclarations d'origines.
• Vous maîtrisez le français et l’allemand, tant à l’oral qu’à l’écrit. L'anglais est un plus.
• Vous possédez de très bonnes connaissances de la suite Microsoft Office, et des bonnes connaissances d'un ERP.
• Vous êtes une personne autonome, précise et rigoureuse, organisée et dotée d’une bonne capacité à travailler en équipe. Notre offre Vous aurez l'occasion de vous immerger dans le monde du travail et d'acquérir une expérience variée et passionnante dans une entreprise familiale internationale. Nous vous offrons la possibilité d’effectuer des tâches intéressantes et d’avoir des responsabilités ainsi que de développer vos idées. Vous serez formé(e), soutenu(e) et accompagné(e) par une équipe dynamique. Vous bénéficierez de conditions de travail modernes telles que des horaires de travail flexibles, la possibilité de travailler en Home office, un restaurant d'entreprise et de nombreux autres avantages. Le lieu de travail se situe à Bulle, dans la belle région de la Gruyère. Planifiez avec nous votre développement personnel et professionnel. Ce poste est soumis à une procédure de vérification des antécédents. Afin de garantir une procédure de candidature équitable, nous n’acceptons pas les candidatures par courrier postal ou électronique. Avons-nous suscité votre intérêt ? Si c’est le cas, nous serions ravis de recevoir votre candidature en ligne. Si vous avez des questions, veuillez contacter Boris KOLLY. One Passion. Many Opportunities. *Une passion commune. Tant d’opportunités. L'entreprise Liebherr Machines Bulle SA est le centre de compétences des moteurs à combustion (diesel et gaz) et composants hydrauliques. L’entreprise développe et fabrique des produits diversifiés utilisés dans le génie civil, l'exploitation minière, l'agriculture, l'énergie décentralisée, l'ingénierie mécanique et industrielle ainsi que l'aviation. ​​ Site Liebherr Machines Bulle SA 7, Rue Hans-Liebherr 1630 Bulle Suisse (CH) Contact Boris KOLLY 026 913 31 11

jobs.title: Group CO₂ Specialist (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
As our Group CO₂ Specialist , you will help shape how the Liebherr Group measures, manages, and advances its climate ambitions. In this hands-on, cross-functional role, you will strengthen our decarbonization efforts, improve emissions data quality and governance, and translate strategic CO2 goals into operational reality across 13 product segments. You are analytical, pragmatic and collaborative. You thrive at the intersection of data, strategy, and leadership, partnering closely with namely engineering, operations, sustainability, finance, and top management to deliver measurable impact. Responsibilities: 1. Group-Level CO₂ Measurement & Reporting
• Support the implementation and continuous improvement Group-wide CO₂ accounting and reporting processes.
• Help ensure alignment with key reporting frameworks such as CSRD, Greenhouse Gas Protocol, and other relevant standards.
• Contribute to the consolidation of emissions data across all product segments, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and audit readiness.
• Support the reporting of climate-related disclosures for annual and sustainability reports. 2. CO₂ Governance & Strategy
• Help define, implement, and oversee the Group’s CO₂ governance framework, ensuring clear roles, responsibilities, and decision-making structures.
• Support the integration of CO₂ considerations into business planning, product development, and operational processes.
• Support Group-wide decarbonisation initiatives, including target-setting, technical assessments, and roadmap development.
• Evaluate, propose, and help implement CO₂ reduction opportunities across the value chain.
• Monitor progress against Group targets and help track the effectiveness of initiatives. 3. Cross-Functional Coordination & Collaboration
• Act as the central coordination point between Group-level teams and local expert teams across all product segments.
• Facilitate knowledge-sharing, methodology alignment, and consistent CO₂ management practices throughout the Group.
• Support top management with decision-making by providing insights, data analyses, and strategic recommendations. 4. Internal Engagement, Training & Workshops
• Help develop and deliver training, workshops, and guidance materials across the Group including briefings for leadership and updates for broader internal specialist and non-specialist audiences. Competencies:
• Minimum 3+ years of proven experience in sustainability, CO2 strategy, environmental management, or related fields.
• Experience with both CSRD and GHG Protocol required. SBTi, Ecovadis and related reporting or assessment frameworks are a strong asset.
• Practical experience with decarbonisation measures, CO₂ strategy development, and target setting. Experience with product carbon footprint or life cycle assessment would be an asset.
• Experience working with or presenting to top management is highly desirable.
• Experience in a multinational corporate environment is an advantage and experience in the construction industry or similar is preferred.
• University degree in a technical, economic, business, or sustainability-related field.
• Strong analytical and data skills capabilities.
• Ability to translate complex topics into clear, actionable business insights.
• Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder‑management capabilities.
• Structured, detail-oriented and collaborative mindset and ability to work effectively with both Group-level and local expert teams.
• English fluency required in writing and speaking. German fluency is considered a strong advantage. Our offer: We offer you a secure job, progressive and family-friendly employment conditions such as flexible working hours, hybrid working and opportunities for further training Have we awoken your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your online application. If you have any questions, please contact Jeton Tahiri. One Passion. Many Opportunities. The company Liebherr-International AG with its head office in Bulle is the holding company of the Liebherr Group and performs various functions in the areas finance, tax, auditing, legal, insurance, HR, and corporate communication. The Liebherr Group employs more than 55,000 people worldwide in over 150 countries. Location Liebherr-International AG 7, Rue Hans-Liebherr 1630 Bulle Switzerland (CH) Contact Jeton Tahiri jeton.tahiri@liebherr.com

As our Group CO₂ Specialist , you will help shape how the Liebherr Group measures, manages, and advances its climate ambitions. In this hands-on, cross-functional role, you will strengthen our decarbonization efforts, improve emissions data quality and governance, and translate strategic CO2 goals into operational reality across 13 product segments. You are analytical, pragmatic and collaborative. You thrive at the intersection of data, strategy, and leadership, partnering closely with namely engineering, operations, sustainability, finance, and top management to deliver measurable impact. Responsibilities: 1. Group-Level CO₂ Measurement & Reporting
• Support the implementation and continuous improvement Group-wide CO₂ accounting and reporting processes.
• Help ensure alignment with key reporting frameworks such as CSRD, Greenhouse Gas Protocol, and other relevant standards.
• Contribute to the consolidation of emissions data across all product segments, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and audit readiness.
• Support the reporting of climate-related disclosures for annual and sustainability reports. 2. CO₂ Governance & Strategy
• Help define, implement, and oversee the Group’s CO₂ governance framework, ensuring clear roles, responsibilities, and decision-making structures.
• Support the integration of CO₂ considerations into business planning, product development, and operational processes.
• Support Group-wide decarbonisation initiatives, including target-setting, technical assessments, and roadmap development.
• Evaluate, propose, and help implement CO₂ reduction opportunities across the value chain.
• Monitor progress against Group targets and help track the effectiveness of initiatives. 3. Cross-Functional Coordination & Collaboration
• Act as the central coordination point between Group-level teams and local expert teams across all product segments.
• Facilitate knowledge-sharing, methodology alignment, and consistent CO₂ management practices throughout the Group.
• Support top management with decision-making by providing insights, data analyses, and strategic recommendations. 4. Internal Engagement, Training & Workshops
• Help develop and deliver training, workshops, and guidance materials across the Group including briefings for leadership and updates for broader internal specialist and non-specialist audiences. Competencies:
• Minimum 3+ years of proven experience in sustainability, CO2 strategy, environmental management, or related fields.
• Experience with both CSRD and GHG Protocol required. SBTi, Ecovadis and related reporting or assessment frameworks are a strong asset.
• Practical experience with decarbonisation measures, CO₂ strategy development, and target setting. Experience with product carbon footprint or life cycle assessment would be an asset.
• Experience working with or presenting to top management is highly desirable.
• Experience in a multinational corporate environment is an advantage and experience in the construction industry or similar is preferred.
• University degree in a technical, economic, business, or sustainability-related field.
• Strong analytical and data skills capabilities.
• Ability to translate complex topics into clear, actionable business insights.
• Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder‑management capabilities.
• Structured, detail-oriented and collaborative mindset and ability to work effectively with both Group-level and local expert teams.
• English fluency required in writing and speaking. German fluency is considered a strong advantage. titleByLocale.fr: Chef de la sécurité des données (m/w/d)

jobs.description:
We are expanding our Global Corporate Information Security Team and looking forward new colleagues and leaders joining us in Bulle (FR) Switzerland, we are looking for a Head of Data Security reporting to Head of Digital Security at Liebherr International. The scope of duties includes the following: Responsibilities: Oversees the organization’s global data security strategy and implementation to protect sensitive data assets across IT, OT and Cloud Environments, as well as Global Leadership of Data Security Team, Products and Services.
• Develop and implement a comprehensive data security strategy aligned with business objectives and regulatory requirements.
• Oversee data security, labeling, and access control mechanisms in collaboration with Data Governance.
• Implement and manage data encryption and data loss prevention (DLP) solutions.
• Manage data encryption and key management systems (e.g. PKI)
• Develop and enforce data protection strategies, and compliance frameworks (e.g., GDPR) in collaboration with Data Protection.
• Conduct regular risk assessments to identify vulnerabilities in data storage, processing, and transmission.
• Collaborate with IT, legal, and business teams to secure sensitive data across all platforms.
• Manage incident response for data breaches, including investigation, remediation, and reporting.
• Implement monitoring and technical auditing mechanisms to track data access and usage across the organization.
• Drive data security awareness and training programs to reinforce best practices among employees. Competencies:
• Bachelor’s/Master’s in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or related field.
• 5+ years in cybersecurity and 3+ years in a leadership role.
• Following certificates are preferred; CISSP or CISM.
• English is a Must, German and French are a plus.
• Excellent knowledge of data security concepts, principles including data governance frameworks (e.g., GDPR, CCPA)
• Knowledge of data security technologies and tools (e.g., DLP, cloud encryption, tokenization).
• Experience with cryptographic solutions and protocols (e.g., PKI, PGP, KMS, HSM)
• Ability to think critically and solve complex problems
• Ability to communicate technical topics to non-technical audiences
• Ability to manage and collaborate with stakeholders
• Project management
• Readiness for global travel Our offer: We offer you a secure job, progressive and family-friendly employment conditions such as flexible working hours, hybrid working and opportunities for further training Have we awoken your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your online application. If you have any questions, please contact Regina Abou el Naga. One Passion. Many Opportunities. The company Liebherr-International AG with its head office in Bulle is the holding company of the Liebherr Group and performs various functions in the areas finance, tax, auditing, legal, insurance, HR, and corporate communication. The Liebherr Group employs more than 55,000 people worldwide in over 150 countries. Location Liebherr-International AG 7, Rue Hans-Liebherr 1630 Bulle Switzerland (CH) Contact Regina Abou el Naga regina.abouelnaga@liebherr.com

jobs.description:
Your responsibilities
• As a Project Purchasing Manager, you are the primary person responsible for purchasing for the defined project portfolio,
• You lead all purchasing activities related to your projects,
• You manage purchases from the concept phase through to production (PPAP),
• You coordinate with the different departments to achieve the set objectives,
• You anticipate supplier capacity and conduct market analyses for innovation, sharing relevant project information with your team,
• You manage supplier contracts and ensure follow-up with the commodity team,
• You lead sourcing meetings for supplier allocation,
• You ensure part replacement and updates during project phases,
• You define and implement the sourcing strategy. Your profile
• You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Economics, Purchasing, or Project Management,
• You have proven experience in project management or strategic purchasing,
• You have initial experience in electronics, mechanics, or a similar field,
• You hold an IPMA Level D certification,
• You are fluent in French and English; German is a plus,
• You have very good knowledge of MS Office and an ERP system,
• You stand out for your team spirit, versatility, and your approach to process management,
• You excel in communication, negotiation, and have a strong ability to persuade. Our offer Can we inspire you to take on a responsible position in a dynamic and independent family business? We offer you room for ideas, a secure job, modern and family-friendly employment conditions such as flexible working hours, home office, a company restaurant, training opportunities as well as many benefits. The workplace is located in Bulle, surrounded by the wonderful nature of the Gruyère region. Start planning your personal and professional development with us. In order to ensure a fair application process, we cannot accept applications by post or email. This position is subject to a background check process. Have we awoken your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your online application. If you have any questions, please contact Boris KOLLY. One Passion. Many Opportunities. The company ​Liebherr Machines Bulle SA is the centre of excellence for combustion engines (diesel and gas engines) and hydraulic components (axial piston pumps and motors). descriptionByLocale.en:
Your Responsibilities
• You are responsible for troubleshooting and diagnosing complete engines and hydraulic components, as well as their individual parts, in collaboration with the mechanic colleagues
• You analyze fault patterns, identify their root causes, and present them in a clear and comprehensible manner
• You document your investigations in technical reports
• You participate in internal and external meetings and provide technical support (e.g., Customer Service, Supplier Management, Research & Development) Your Profile
• You have completed vocational training (EFZ/CFC) as a mechanic or mechatronics technician in the automotive, truck, construction machinery, or agricultural machinery sectors
• You have advanced training as a diagnostic technician or are willing to obtain the diagnostic technician qualification
• You have several years of professional experience and a strong affinity for diagnostics and root cause analysis
• You have very good German and good English language skills; knowledge of French is an advantage
• You are proficient in MS Office
• You are proactive, reliable, responsible, and a commited team player Our offer Can we inspire you to take on a responsible position in a dynamic and independent family business? We offer you room for ideas, a secure job, modern and family-friendly employment conditions such as flexible working hours, home office, a company restaurant, training opportunities as well as many benefits. The workplace is located in Bulle, surrounded by the wonderful nature of the Gruyère region. Start planning your personal and professional development with us. In order to ensure a fair application process, we cannot accept applications by post or email. This position is subject to a background check process; the process is conducted by our partner Aequivalent. Have we awoken your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your online application. If you have any questions, please contact Anna KOMARDINA. One Passion. Many Opportunities. The company ​Liebherr Machines Bulle SA is the centre of excellence for combustion engines (diesel and gas engines) and hydraulic components (axial piston pumps and motors). The company develops and produces various products, which find their use in building construction and civil engineering, mining, agriculture, decentralised energy, machine and plant engineering, as well as aerospace. Location Liebherr Machines Bulle SA 7, Rue Hans-Liebherr 1630 Bulle Switzerland (CH) Contact Anna KOMARDINA +41 26 913 31 11

Your Responsibilities In this position, you are responsible for the daily management of a purchasing portfolio,
• You are in charge of analyzing the portfolio, sorting offers, updating prices, and handling the related administrative tasks,

• You manage supplier-related risks, handle resulting crises, and implement corrective actions,

• You have 1 to 2 years of experience as a buyer in the automotive, construction equipment, aviation, or railway sectors,
• You have good knowledge of French, German, and English,
• You are proficient with an ERP system, SharePoint (intranet), and MS Office,
• You are organized, flexible, have strong analytical skills, and an excellent ability to work in a team. You are open to developing your skills in the field and are results-oriented. jobs.description:
As part of the Global Data Governance team, this role has the unique opportunity to shape the future of data products and data valuation at Liebherr. The goal will be to support the development of the data product foundation and build a standardized and scalable data value framework – focusing on identifying, evaluating, and maximizing the business impact of data-driven use cases across divisions. We are looking for a graduate student (or soon-to-graduate) who is interested in learning on the job and contributing to the fascinating topic of data product & value management. This is a temporary engagement with a duration of 12 months. Responsibilities: Global Data Governance
• Explore the role of data governance within the Liebherr Group, i.e., goals, scope, responsibilities, operating model, communities etc.
• Align the activities around data product & value management with Liebherr’s global data strategy Data Products
• Learn about data products, what it means and how it fits into Liebherr
• Support the creation and implementation of the global data product framework
• Co-facilitate and contribute to the cross-divisional expert group on data products
• Support the onboarding & piloting of the data product concept within divisions
• Move from concept to reality, i.e., train stakeholders to build and manage data products
• Assist in documentation and communication activities Data Value
• Identify and estimate business impact of data-driven use cases
• Support the application and optimization of the data value approach
• Contribute to the standardization of templates, metrics, and valuation logic
• Automate the use-case documentation and valuation process
• Develop dashboards and reports for value tracking
• Scale the valuation approach across the entire company Competencies:
• Strong analytical and structured thinking skills
• Proactiveness and diligence in problem-solving
• Impeccable communication and storytelling abilities
• Advanced Excel skills (modelling, calculations)
• Fluency in English, French or German would be an asset.
• Experience with Power BI and Databricks or similar tools is a plus
• Experience with prompting and building AI agents is a plus
• Prior understanding of master data management, SAP MDG or practical experience with data & analytics governance topics would be an asset
• Hands‑on mentality with a strong willingness to learn and explore new topics
• Enjoys collaborating in an international environment Our offer:
• A unique opportunity to gain practical experience in a strategic data governance environment of a globally operating company

Your Responsibilities As ‘Team Leader Strategic Purchasing’, you are responsible for managing the team and making strategic decisions for your field,
• You are responsible for implementing organisational and process changes,
• You define and manage the execution of the product segment strategy,
• You manage cost performance and associated reduction plans,
• You contribute to analyses, decision-making and the implementation of ‘Make or Buy’ measures,
• You support product change management through purchasing actions,
• You are responsible for managing risks related to strategic purchasing activities, supplier risks and product segments,
• You are responsible for benchmarking product portfolios,
• You actively and proactively participate in internal and supplier problem-solving activities. Your Profile
• You have technical or economic background,
• You have solid experience in strategic purchasing in a technical field,
• You are fluent in French and have a very good level of English,
• You are proficient in MS Office, intranet and ERP systems,
• You are flexible, independent, reliable and have a strong team spirit. Our Offer Can we motivate you to take on a key role in a dynamic, independent family-owned company? We encourage you to share and develop your ideas, and we offer you a secure job with modern working conditions that support work–life balance, such as flexible working hours, the possibility of working from home, a company restaurant, opportunities for continuing education, and many other benefits. The workplace is located in Bulle, in the beautiful Gruyère region. Plan your personal and professional development with us. This position is subject to a background check process; the process is conducted by our partner Aequivalent. To ensure a fair application process, we do not accept applications by postal mail or email. Have we awoken your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your online application. If you have any questions, please contact Nadege MALAN. One Passion. Many Opportunities. The company ​Liebherr Machines Bulle SA is the centre of excellence for combustion engines (diesel and gas engines) and hydraulic components (axial piston pumps and motors). The company develops and produces various products, which find their use in building construction and civil engineering, mining, agriculture, decentralised energy, machine and plant engineering, as well as aerospace. Location Liebherr Machines Bulle SA 7, Rue Hans-Liebherr 1630 Bulle Switzerland (CH) Contact Nadege MALAN 026 913 31 11

descriptionByLocale.it: Designazione delle merci Le vostre responsabilità Come acquisto strategico di Team Leader., siete responsabili della gestione del team e del prendere decisioni strategiche per il vostro campo, - siete responsabili dell'implementazione di modifiche organizzative e di processo, - definire e gestire l'esecuzione della strategia del segmento di prodotto, - gestire le prestazioni dei costi e i piani di riduzione associati, - contribuire alle analisi, al processo decisionale e all'implementazione di misure di.Make or Buy., - sostenere la gestione dei cambiamenti di prodotto attraverso azioni di acquisto, - è responsabile della gestione dei rischi connessi all'acquisto strategico attività, rischi per i fornitori e segmenti di prodotto, - Sei responsabile per il benchmarking dei portafogli di prodotti, - Partecipa attivamente e proattivamente alle attività interne e di soluzione dei problemi dei fornitori. Il tuo profilo - Hai una solida esperienza nell'acquisto strategico in un campo tecnico, - sei fluente in francese e hai un ottimo livello di inglese, - sei esperto in uffici MS, intranet ed ERP sistemi, - sei flessibile, indipendente, affidabile e hai uno spirito di squadra forte. La nostra offerta Possiamo farvi assumere un ruolo chiave in un'azienda familiare dinamica e indipendente? Vi invitiamo a condividere e sviluppare le vostre idee e vi offriamo un lavoro sicuro con condizioni di lavoro moderne che sostengono l'equilibrio lavorativo.vita, come orari di lavoro flessibili, la possibilità di lavorare da casa, un ristorante aziendale, opportunità per l'istruzione continua, e molti altri vantaggi. Il posto di lavoro si trova a Bulle, nella splendida regione di Gruyère. Pianificate con noi il vostro sviluppo personale e professionale. Questa posizione è soggetta a un processo di controllo di sfondo; il processo è condotto dal nostro partner Aequivalente. Per garantire un processo di applicazione equo, non accettiamo le domande per posta o e-mail. Abbiamo risvegliato il vostro interesse? Allora non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra applicazione online. Se avete domande, si prega di contattare Nadege MALAN. Informazioni sulla società L'azienda Liebherr Machines Bulle SA è il centro di eccellenza per i motori a combustione (motori diesel e a gas) e i componenti idraulici (pompe a pistoni assiali e motori). L'azienda sviluppa e produce vari prodotti, che trovano il loro utilizzo in edilizia e ingegneria civile, mineraria, agricola, energetica decentrata, macchine e impiantistica, così come aerospaziale. Ubicazione Liebherr Machines Bulle SA 7, Rue Hans-Liebherr 1630 Bulle Svizzera (CH) Contatto Nadege MALAN 026 913 31 11

Warenbezeichnung
• Ihre Verantwortung Als „Team Leader Strategic Purchasing" sind Sie verantwortlich für die Verwaltung des Teams und die strategische Entscheidungsfindung für Ihr Gebiet, - Sie sind verantwortlich für die Durchführung von organisatorischen und Prozessänderungen, - Sie definieren und verwalten die Ausführung der Produktsegmentstrategie, - Sie verwalten Kostenleistung und damit verbundene Reduktionspläne, - Sie tragen zu Analysen, Entscheidungsfindung und der Umsetzung von „Make or Buy, Maßnahmen, - Sie unterstützen Produktänderungsmanagement durch Kaufaktionen, - Sie sind verantwortlich für die Steuerung von Risiken im Zusammenhang mit strategischem Einkauf Aktivitäten, Lieferantenrisiken und Produktsegmente, - Sie sind verantwortlich für Benchmarking Produktportfolios, - Sie aktiv und proaktiv an internen und Lieferanten Problemlösungsaktivitäten teilnehmen.
• Ihr Profil - Sie haben technische oder wirtschaftliche Hintergründe, - Sie haben solide Erfahrung im strategischen Einkauf in einem technischen Bereich, - Sie sprechen fließend Französisch und haben ein sehr gutes Niveau an Englisch, - Sie sind in MS Office-, Intranet- und ERP-Systemen kompetent, - Sie sind flexibel, unabhängig, zuverlässig und haben einen starken Teamgeist. Unser Angebot Können wir Sie motivieren, eine Schlüsselrolle in einem dynamischen, unabhängigen Familienunternehmen zu übernehmen? Wir ermutigen Sie, Ihre Ideen zu teilen und zu entwickeln, und wir bieten Ihnen einen sicheren Job mit modernen Arbeitsbedingungen, die Work-Life-Balance unterstützen, wie flexible Arbeitszeiten, die Möglichkeit der Arbeit von zu Hause aus, ein Unternehmensrestaurant, Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und viele andere Vorteile. Der Arbeitsplatz befindet sich in Bulle, in der schönen Region Gruyère. Planen Sie Ihre persönliche und berufliche Entwicklung mit uns. Diese Position unterliegt einem Hintergrundcheckprozess; der Prozess wird von unserem Partner Aequivalent durchgeführt. Um einen fairen Bewerbungsprozess zu gewährleisten, akzeptieren wir keine Bewerbungen per Post oder E-Mail. Haben wir Ihr Interesse geweckt? Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre Online-Bewerbung. Bei Fragen wenden Sie sich bitte an Nadege MALAN. Unternehmensinformation Die Firma Liebherr Machines Bulle SA ist das Kompetenzzentrum für Verbrennungsmotoren (Diesel- und Gasmotoren) und hydraulische Komponenten (Axialkolbenpumpen und Motoren) und entwickelt und produziert verschiedene Produkte, die im Bau- und Tiefbau, im Bergbau, in der Landwirtschaft, im dezentralen Energie-, Maschinen- und Anlagenbau sowie in der Luft- und Raumfahrt eingesetzt werden. jobs.title: Executive assistant (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
Your Responsibilities
• As an Executive Assistant (m/f/x), you will support senior management in the day-to-day running of the company’s operations whilst helping to implement the organisation’s strategy,
• You will play an active role in strategic projects (organisational and technical developments), coordinating and monitoring the objectives and performance indicators of key projects,
• You will contribute to the continuous improvement of internal processes, manage sensitive information relating to strategy, finance and human resources, and ensure compliance with regulatory and confidentiality requirements,
• You manage and optimise the Executive’s diaries, communications, business travel and priorities to ensure effective time management and a high level of responsiveness,
• You organise and coordinate strategic meetings, executive events, site visits, conferences and stakeholder engagements, ensuring flawless execution,
• You draft documents such as correspondence, presentations, reports, meeting minutes and internal communications, in collaboration with the relevant stakeholders,
• You coordinate cross-functional activities with the various departments, external partners and Group entities to foster collaboration,
• You oversee various administrative and operational activities, including budget monitoring, contract management, tasks related to our ERP system, and translations. Your Profil
• You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in business administration, project management or a similar field,
• You have at least 3 to 5 years’ experience as an executive assistant; experience as a project manager is an advantage,
• You are fluent in French and English and have a good knowledge of German,
• You are proficient in MS Office and have a good knowledge of an ERP system,
• You are organised, flexible and have good prioritisation skills,
• You stand out for your independence, communication skills and proactivity. Our Offer Can we inspire you to take on a responsible position in a dynamic and independent family business? We offer you room for ideas, a secure job, modern and family-friendly employment conditions such as flexible working hours, home office, a company restaurant, training opportunities as well as many benefits. The workplace is located in Bulle, surrounded by the wonderful nature of the Gruyère region. Start planning your personal and professional development with us. In order to ensure a fair application process, we cannot accept applications by post or email. • Sei fluente in francese e inglese e hai una buona conoscenza del tedesco,
• Sei esperto in MS Office e hai una buona conoscenza di un sistema ERP,

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Vos responsabilités
• En tant qu'Assistant Exécutif (m/f/x), vous accompagnerez les cadres supérieurs dans le fonctionnement quotidien des opérations de l'entreprise tout en contribuant à la mise en œuvre de la stratégie de l'organisation,
• Vous jouerez un rôle actif dans les projets stratégiques (développements organisationnels et techniques), la coordination et le suivi des objectifs et des indicateurs de performance des projets clés,
• Vous contribuerez à l'amélioration continue des processus internes, gérerez les informations sensibles concernant la stratégie, les finances et les ressources humaines, et assurerez le respect des exigences réglementaires et de confidentialité,
• Vous gérez et optimisez les agendas Executive, les communications, les voyages d'affaires et les priorités pour assurer une gestion efficace du temps et un haut niveau de réactivité,
• Vous organisez et coordonnez des réunions stratégiques, des événements exécutifs, des visites de sites, des conférences et des engagements des parties prenantes, garantissant une exécution sans faille,
• Vous rédigez des documents tels que la correspondance, les présentations, les rapports, les procès-verbaux de réunion et les communications internes, en collaboration avec les parties prenantes concernées,
• Vous coordonnez les activités interfonctionnelles avec les différents départements, partenaires externes et entités du Groupe pour favoriser la collaboration,
• Vous supervisez diverses activités administratives et opérationnelles, y compris le suivi du budget, la gestion des contrats, les tâches liées à notre système de PGI et les traductions. Votre profil
